method: Blind visual inspection of all four full reference PNGs individually first, followed by every full candidate PNG in the supplied candidate and capture order using view_image, paired by screen. Scores conservatively cover both sizes against the references, not relative improvement; 9 requires the same painted hand. Large text and scrolling are intentional. Unseen scroll content is not treated as inaccessible, and no interaction behavior is inferred. Standalone preview banners and unchanged combat room, actor, and hand art are excluded; combat background judgment concerns the visible surrounding decorative treatment. Combat UI differences were not materially distinguishable, so its scores are tied and ranking uses supplied order as a neutral tie-break.

winner_fixes: Gameover: repaint the right deck row surfaces with worn aubergine enamel, localized candle highlights and darker inset edges while preserving the separate title and quantity areas.
Rest, event, gameover and shop: give the upper lavender headings irregular painted bevels, fine wear and directional highlights comparable to the title reference, preserving current text sizes.
Rest: replace the square right-hand result badge patches with fitted worn-brass cartouches whose ends and shading match the choice frame.
Event: reduce the physical height and ornament scale of the STORY REGISTER lip, fit its ends to the paper frame and keep the recessed parchment visibly continuing behind it.

Gameover: preserve the separate portrait captions, dedicated HOW FAR region and complete cabinet presentation; soften the heavy bottom memorial rail with proportionate carved modules and fitted corner joins.
Combat-floaters: sharpen cyan and red condition letter faces, reduce the diffuse halo and strengthen small dark recesses while retaining readable local owner headings.
Shop: preserve the curtain, vendor, three-card shelf and price-tag staging; give the lower reading lip smaller carved modules and a plaque that sits physically within its brass face.
Rest: add subtle directional wear and localized reflected candlelight to the large choice-panel surfaces so their material feels as painted as the fort illustration.
